note: The ordering conflict test appends records whose source sequence and event time disagree with commit_index while replay remains commit ordered.
The identity collision test preserves two records with the same envelope identity and distinct record_id values.
The ledger contract and runtime pressure report state that integrity verifies preservation of committed content, not truth of the observed event.
The runtime pressure runner emits scenario evidence while unit tests contain dedicated guarantee-specific assertions.
Most runtime scenarios mark pass using integrity status and replayed record_id order; dedicated tests verify guarantee-specific distinctions.
Replay parses records and sorts them by commit_index rather than treating physical JSONL line order as the canonical definition.
The contract distinguishes record integrity from full-history integrity, and the v0 implementation verifies per-record content without hash chaining.
